proofBoundary: proves only normalization, validation, timeout and reconciliation behavior for an injected read-only GitHub client interface

the injected client is assumed read-only by capability contract; this evidence does not independently prove its implementation performs no writes
provider response authenticity and authenticated transport are not proved by this slice
